distribution.reason: Local reference candidate. Direct, proxy, native and checker lanes qualified; installed-inventory re-admission pending under the current gate; anonymous digest-bound source delivery and publication remain incomplete. No publication authorized.

constraints: Linux amd64, glibc 2.41; exact module closure supplied locally. Native slot IDs are assigned by SoftHSM; a consumer slot index is a different value.
Initialize only an empty writable /var/lib/p11lab volume; tokens are private to the named softhsm2 directory. Compatible init is non-destructive; partial or incompatible state fails.
PIN_FILE/SO_PIN_FILE are preferred; scalar alternatives are explicit disposable-test inputs. Conflicting scalar/file or absent/empty credentials fail initial provisioning.
Runtime controls/config are recreated under writable /run/p11lab by every exec invocation. The adapter preserves argv and native/application exit status.
Ordinary application consumers do not require checker, Python, tracing or a workspace mount. Reset is an explicit removal/replacement of disposable state; no automatic reset or retry.
Whole-image licensing, source companion delivery and digest-bound admission remain separate requirements.
